size.note: Newman's 115 cm. Wikipedia 95–115 cm. Newman's species page uses Torgos tracheliotus (single i); IOC spelling tracheliotos.

habitat: Bushveld; in arid west thornveld and desert. Usually pairs; dominates other vultures at carcasses (Newman's; SABAP1).
summary: Huge massive-billed vulture with crimson bare head and neck, dark body, streaked underparts and white 'pants' in adults. Immature has dark pants and mottled mantle (Newman's).

similar.note: White-headed has a white head and underparts and a blue-and-red bill (Newman's).

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^6=64 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 32–128. No newer park-wide count applied here; keep Kemp until a Tier A nest survey figure is wired in.
